# Wharf 0.12.0 changes

- Added `Wharf.Execution` phase resource and timeout policies.
- Added independent build, agent, and verifier resource gates.
- Added timeout multipliers and explicit phase timeout overrides.
- Added bounded infrastructure retry classification.
- Added separate JSONL infrastructure-retry evidence with immutable retry IDs.
- Added saturation, retry, timeout, excluded-failure, and logical-accounting
  tests.
